_comment: This disabled file documents the FastRun datapack format.
Set enabled to true and change match.type or match.item to use it.
main_priority chooses which rule wins when multiple files match the same item or type.
animations[].priority chooses which animation set is tried first inside this rule.
If a set defines left_step and right_step, both step animations and run must resolve; otherwise the whole set is skipped.
If a set only defines run, the mod uses that run animation with procedural step pulses.
run wom:biped/skill/biped_sprint means use this mod's default WOM weapon sprint family.
run wom:biped/skill/biped_sprint_barehand means use this mod's default WOM barehand sprint family.
If WOM is not installed, WOM default sprint entries are skipped and the next animations[] entry is tried.
If no rule matches, no-WOM FastRun uses the configured noWomProceduralWeaponFastRun fallback or EpicParCool's default FastRun animation.
FastRun step no longer requires WOM Natural Sprinter. With Natural Sprinter available it consumes that step resource; otherwise it uses the genericFastRunStepCooldownTicks config.
